visual.pregunta: Explain how a forest can act as a carbon sink, a carbon store or a carbon source.
visual.floja: A forest can be a sink when it takes in carbon, a store when it keeps carbon and a source when it releases carbon, for example when it burns.
tachar: a sink when it takes in carbon
a source when it releases carbon
visual.porque: Three labels, no net carbon change, no processes, no caveat: about 3/7.
puntos: Label depends on net carbon change: inputs − outputs
Inputs: photosynthesis. Outputs: respiration, decomposition, combustion
Caveat: mature forests can remain sinks
Burned / cleared forest: outputs > inputs → source
visual.clave: Compare inputs and outputs for every case

visual.mal: Extracting coal is a transformation, because the carbon leaves the lithosphere.
visual.bien: Extraction is a transfer: the coal moves but its form is unchanged. Combustion is the transformation.
